source: Mindset's own SAP partner credentials. Official files from SAP via Mindset Slack and mindsetconsulting.com uploads. SAP badges are self-contained artwork: never recolor, crop, or redraw them. Vector masters live in SAP PartnerEdge (partner login).

badges.name: SAP Gold Partner
badges.notes: Raster only (407x239). Vector master is in SAP PartnerEdge.

badges.name: SAP Gold Partner, Expert in SAP BTP
badges.description: Gold Partner badge with Expert competency in SAP Business Technology Platform: Database and Data Management, Application Development and Integration, Analytics and Planning.
badges.notes: Use this for 'SAP BTP partner'. Replaces the Advanced badge.

badges.name: SAP AppHaus Network member
badges.description: Member of the SAP AppHaus Network. Mindset runs the first US-based SAP AppHaus, in Minneapolis.
badges.notes: Background removed for on-light. On-dark turns the black ink white and keeps the SAP mark in its own colors.

badges.name: SAP Gold Partner, Advanced in SAP BTP
badges.description: Earlier Advanced competency badge for SAP BTP.
badges.notes: Superseded by the Expert badge in October 2024. Kept for history. Don't use in new work.
